```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", echo = FALSE)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
# Rendered from inst/DIFFERENCES.md rather than restated, so the ledger has one
# home. Entries are added when a golden test forces the question, which is why
# the list is short: if a difference is not here, the goldens say the two agree.
cat(readLines(system.file("DIFFERENCES.md", package = "xucinet"), warn = FALSE),
    sep = "\n")
```
